INSERT INTO `farm`
user_id, farm_name, farm_code, img_url, contact_phone, address, total_area, area_unit, longitude, latitude, status, remark,
#{userId}, #{farmName}, #{farmCode}, #{imgUrl}, #{contactPhone}, #{address}, #{totalArea}, #{areaUnit}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{status}, #{remark},
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `farm` f LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS farmTotalCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `plot` p INNER JOIN `farm` pf ON pf.id = p.farm_id WHERE (#{userId} IS NULL OR pf.user_id = #{userId})), 0) AS plotTotalCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(f.total_area, 0)), 2), 0) AS farmTotalArea, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.status IS NULL OR f.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabledFarmCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(f.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(f.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS farmTotalTrend, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `plot` p INNER JOIN `farm` pf ON pf.id = p.farm_id WHERE (#{userId} IS NULL OR pf.user_id = #{userId}) AND DATE(p.create_time) = CURDATE()), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `plot` p INNER JOIN `farm` pf ON pf.id = p.farm_id WHERE (#{userId} IS NULL OR pf.user_id = #{userId}) AND DATE(p.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS plotTotalTrend, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(f.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN COALESCE(f.total_area, 0) ELSE 0 END), 2), 0) - COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(f.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN COALESCE(f.total_area, 0) ELSE 0 END), 2), 0) AS farmTotalAreaTrend, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (f.status IS NULL OR f.status = 1) AND DATE(f.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (f.status IS NULL OR f.status = 1) AND DATE(f.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabledFarmTrend FROM `farm` f WHERE (#{userId} IS NULL OR f.user_id = #{userId})

SELECT f.id, f.farm_name, f.img_url, f.total_area, f.area_unit, f.address, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `plot` p WHERE p.farm_id = f.id) AS plot_count FROM `farm` f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND (f.status IS NULL OR f.status = 1) ORDER BY f.id DESC
